rationale: Round 2 substantively fixes four of R5's five prior asks: ADR-0041 rollback is now explicitly a reversal, the ADR-0037 exemption is honestly paths-only and narrowly tested, OQ-4 cites the governing ADR-0023 row at line 140, and AC-4/AC-5 now pin the ADR-0035 recovery form. The ADR-0025 ask is only partial because the document still calls its amendment conditional in three scope/touchpoint locations despite correctly stating that both admissible R5 directions require it. A new ADR-0042 falsifiability gap remains: R6.4/AC-11 require bd stderr passthrough but test only benign printable text, so raw control-bearing stderr can satisfy the AC while violating the declared per-line termsafe contract.
concrete_changes_required: Make the ADR-0025 amendment unambiguously mandatory for R5 by replacing the surviving 'conditional R5 clarification' / 'priced conditional amendment' wording at spec.md lines 80, 87, and 154. The document already establishes at R5.1/R5.3 that every admissible direction amends ADR-0025 and that there is no no-amendment leg; the ADR Touchpoints and Scope lists must say the same thing.

Extend R6.4 and AC-11 to pin ADR-0042 rendering, not only content passthrough: inject multi-line bd stderr containing at least one raw control-bearing or otherwise termsafe-sensitive line, require the legitimate schema-error text to survive, require each surfaced line to route through termsafe.Escape, and assert that no raw control byte reaches the rendered error. The current benign `depends_on_id`-style assertion remains green under an unsafe raw-stderr implementation.

findings.summary: The prior ADR-0041 rollback-pricing ask is addressed.
findings.evidence: ADR-0041:103-105 states 'Never a rollback', ADR-0041:144-153 pins forward reconciliation, and ADR-0041:372-380 rejects rollback. The revised touchpoint, R4.4, and OQ-1(b) now all identify rollback as a reversal requiring an ADR-0041 amendment while distinguishing it from option (a)'s gate-ordering reversal and option (c)'s ADR-0041-conforming path.

findings.summary: The prior OQ-1(c) exemption-narrowness ask is addressed by an honest paths-only contract.
findings.evidence: R4.2 now uses ADR-0025's exact named-artifact list, today only `.beads/issues.jsonl`, expressly rejects a `.beads/**` glob, drops the unprovable authorship predicate, and records the any-actor residual. AC-7 separately pins non-artifact, mixed, any-actor named-artifact-only, and unlisted `.beads/config.yaml` cases. This is a narrow amendment of ADR-0037 section 4, not the general warn-on-staleness alternative rejected at ADR-0037:590-593.

findings.summary: The ADR-0025 substance is corrected, but its delivery is still mislabeled conditional.
findings.evidence: ADR-0025:32 says user-authored dirt still blocks and ADR-0025:36 fixes an exact, non-glob artifact list. R5.1 correctly says removing the invoking-checkout user-dirt block amends that sentence; R5.3 correctly says `--allow-dirty` also amends it and that there is no no-amendment leg. Yet Documentation Surfaces, the ADR-0025 touchpoint heading, and In Scope still call the ADR-0025 change conditional. Since every live R5 outcome requires the amendment, those labels contradict the normative pricing and leave the plan's required ADR deliverable ambiguous.

findings.summary: The prior OQ-4 citation ask is addressed, and the editorial resolution remains correct.
findings.evidence: Direct verification shows ADR-0023:107 is the stale original some-closed row and ADR-0023:140 is the governing spec-095 amended row deriving implement; line 142 is the all-open row. All four spec references now cite line 140, and striking or supersede-annotating line 107 is the correct editorial action.

findings.summary: The prior ADR-0035 recovery-form consistency ask is addressed for the two identified diagnostics.
findings.evidence: AC-4 now requires indeterminate complete-tail guidance to end in a copy-pastable final `recovery:` line, and AC-5(iv) requires any retained phase-mismatch warning to end in a safe inspection-first recovery line. AC-5(ii) separately pins the repair-phase refusal's final recovery. These match ADR-0035:39-53 and avoid the backward write prohibited by R3.

findings.summary: AC-11 does not make the ADR-0042 free-text rendering touchpoint red-on-revert.
findings.evidence: ADR-0042:121-129 requires agent-writable error bodies to pass termsafe.Escape per field and per line. R6.4 requires bd stderr content to surface, while AC-11 injects only a printable schema-error line and asserts containment. A raw `fmt.Errorf(...stderr...)` implementation therefore satisfies AC-11. Existing whole-tree ID-render ratchets address ID-typed positions, but no generic lint proves arbitrary subprocess stderr is per-line termsafe-routed; the current tree's explicit `escapeLines` helper illustrates that this needs a render-site obligation and hostile test.

findings.summary: Reviewed artifact and validation identity were verified.
findings.evidence: HEAD is exactly 8a13b898fc8822f991c0a253fc642e8427f5fc57 and spec.md has no diff from that commit. `mindspec validate spec 128-lifecycle-verb-state-honesty` reports only the expected draft-state warning that the spec has no beads epic and must be approved; it reports no structural spec error.
